title: SentinelMesh Raw Event
description: One flagged or unflagged event emitted by the Event Simulator / Rule-Based Detector, from any of the three data streams (camera, badge, network).

event_id.description: Globally unique ID for this event.

source.description: Which data stream this event came from.

event_type.description: Specific kind of event. Not a strict enum because each source has its own vocabulary — keep values consistent within your team (see examples).

entity.description: The person, device, or account this event is attributed to. This is the field the Fusion Engine correlates on.

id.description: Identifier for the entity — employee ID, IP address, device ID, or 'unknown'.

location.description: Physical zone/room for camera and badge events. Null for pure network events with no physical location.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the event occurred.

severity.description: Severity assigned by the Rule-Based Detector at the individual-event level (independent of any later incident-level severity).

flagged.description: Whether the Rule-Based Detector flagged this event as suspicious. Unflagged events are normal background noise and should NOT be passed to the Fusion Engine.

rule_triggered.description: Name/ID of the rule that caused flagged=true. Null if flagged=false.

raw_details.description: Source-specific free-form extra fields (kept loose on purpose so each source can carry different metadata). Not used by the Fusion Engine directly, but useful for the dashboard's explain-why view and for Claude's summary.
